_comment: Pinned rclone release used for the bundled binary. Artifact keys use Node's/electron-builder's arch naming (x64, arm64), not rclone's own uname-style release filenames — keep in sync with binaryResolver.ts and electron-builder.yml's ${arch} macro. sha256 values verified against the PGP-signed SHA256SUMS published at https://github.com/rclone/rclone/releases/download/v1.69.0/SHA256SUMS. Update deliberately, not automatically, and re-verify the M1 2FA continuation spike (see plan docs) against any new version before bumping.
